text: べんきょうも　いいけど…　やっぱ　ポケモンも　いいんだな

structure.jp: べんきょうも　いいけど…
やっぱ　ポケモンも　いいんだな
structure.en: Pokémon really are good as well, huh

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts of a sentence with the meaning 'but'. いいけど = 'it's good, but'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short spoken form of のだ; here it shows he has just come to realise something. いいんだ = 'so they are good'.
